params.prompt: Educational animation reference diagram, clean black line art on white, professional textbook style. Title at top: "Squash & Stretch — Volume Conservation". TOP HALF: a bouncing ball arc with a dotted path, five stages numbered 1 to 5 — 1) Normal (in air) a circle, 2) Stretch (falling) a vertical ellipse, 3) Squash (impact) a wide flat ellipse ON the ground line, 4) Stretch (rising) a vertical ellipse, 5) Normal (apex) a circle. Each stage numbered ONCE only, no repeated labels. BOTTOM HALF: the SAME five stages shown on a simple round cartoon character with stubby arms and feet — normal, stretched tall as it falls, squashed wide and flat as it lands with its feet splayed, stretched tall as it rebounds, normal at the apex. A bracket links each ball stage down to its matching character stage. Footer: "Scale X times Scale Y is approximately 1.0 — volume stays constant". No other text.
